summary: Clean on COR. Per-platform symbol selection, argument order, and C-type widths all match the real libc prototypes for stdio handles, strerror_r/__xpg_strerror_r/strerror_s, and the errno accessors; the int64->int32 errnum/errno narrowings are documented and match C `int` assignment semantics.
